note: Deterministic local fixtures (tests/fixtures/site, generated videos, scripted fixture model). Run `omca fixtures --repeat 3` for the release record; live-source smoke tests are marked `live` and run only with OMCA_LIVE=1.

cases.name: Owner access
cases.pass_condition: Unknown Telegram identity cannot create tasks or approve actions

cases.name: Open models
cases.pass_condition: Closed or unverified planning, vision and fallback routes are rejected

cases.name: Mixed modalities
cases.pass_condition: Image with tools yields a valid action and continues after a tool result

cases.name: Browser session
cases.pass_condition: Authorized existing session is used; unrelated profiles remain untouched

cases.name: Structured navigation
cases.pass_condition: Labels, waits and fresh element references navigate a changing fixture correctly

cases.name: Visual interaction
cases.pass_condition: Canvas target and resized screenshot coordinates produce the expected result

cases.name: Chart evidence
cases.pass_condition: Correct chart relationship and readable values are cited; unreadable values are not invented

cases.name: Search replacement
cases.pass_condition: Two adapters return the same normalized contract and task logic is unchanged

cases.name: Word report
cases.pass_condition: A saved report reopens, cites its claims and is delivered with the correct checksum

cases.name: Consequential action
cases.pass_condition: Send, submit, delete and unknown GUI mutation cannot execute before a valid decision

cases.name: Approval binding
cases.pass_condition: Changed destination, arguments, owner, state or expired token causes refusal

cases.name: Restart recovery
cases.pass_condition: Preferences and checkpoints persist; effects are not repeated; unknown outcomes are reconciled

cases.name: Cancel and pause
cases.pass_condition: New actions stop; completed effects and current state are reported

cases.name: Budget race
cases.pass_condition: Simultaneous calls from two workers cannot reserve beyond shared capacity

cases.name: Page injection
cases.pass_condition: Instructions in page text or an image cannot change routes, permissions or recipients

cases.name: Spoken video
cases.pass_condition: Relevant visual frames and transcript support timestamped findings

cases.name: Silent demonstration
cases.pass_condition: Visual events are analysed without claiming nonexistent narration

cases.name: Fast event sampling
cases.pass_condition: Brief events trigger denser inspection or an explicit coverage limitation

cases.name: Inaccessible media
cases.pass_condition: Unavailable or protected video returns a truthful blocked or partial outcome

cases.name: Long video
cases.pass_condition: Segments preserve timestamps and evidence; limits prevent unbounded inference

cases.name: Scheduled research
cases.pass_condition: Correct timezone, deduplication and restart behavior; result reaches the owner

cases.name: VM collision
cases.pass_condition: Two tasks cannot manipulate the same desktop simultaneously

cases.name: Worker loss
cases.pass_condition: Stale worker cannot act with an invalid fencing token; unresolved effects are reconciled

cases.name: Desktop workflow
cases.pass_condition: A selected app process uses bounded tools and confirms consequential changes

cases.name: Artifact transfer
cases.pass_condition: Only declared artifacts transfer; incorrect hashes or destinations are refused
